compounds.title: Residential Compounds Playbook
compounds.summary: Eliminate WhatsApp pass chaos with resident self-service, quota controls, and auditable guard workflows.
steps: Map resident, contractor, and delivery access policies by unit type
Enable signed visitor passes with validity windows and gate assignment
Train guards on scanner-only flow and daily incident exports

schools.title: Private Schools Playbook
schools.summary: Operationalize parent pickup approvals, guard-only scanning, and immutable incident-ready entry logs.
outcomes: Only pre-approved pickup guardians enter campus
Gate queues shrink with scan-first verification
Security teams get exportable audit evidence
steps: Define pickup authorization roles and expiry policy
Issue pickup-specific QR passes and enforce single-use controls
Run weekly audit log reviews with school security leadership

events.title: Mass Events Playbook
events.summary: Move from manual ticket checks to high-throughput signed QR admissions with offline resilience.
outcomes: Faster gate throughput during peak entry windows
Reduced fraud from duplicated or forwarded tickets
steps: Import attendee lists and segment by access tier
Generate single-use signed passes and pre-assign scan zones
Use offline scanner queues and reconcile after connectivity returns

clubs.title: Clubs & Marinas Playbook
clubs.summary: Protect premium member access with schedule-aware QR permissions and per-member visit intelligence.
outcomes: Membership tiers enforced automatically at gates
Shared passes stop working outside policy windows
Operations can track member and guest patterns
steps: Model membership tiers and facility-specific gate rules
Issue signed member credentials with recurring schedules
Monitor revocations, guest quotas, and weekly access anomalies
